sections.brief: Strongest honest version of the diagnosis: Pew trust 77% (1964) to 17% (Sept 2025); Gallup 48% to 28%; GAO HealthCare.gov and 2025 High-Risk List; Kamarck on flat civilian workforce and contractors; CFR pages 1960-2021; Thompson's many hands; Gilens & Page and the Enns/Bashir/Branham dispute; FDR 1933 inaugural vs Yarvin's paraphrase, Emergency Banking Act, Schechter, 1937 court plan, 22nd Amendment. Figures: compare (diagnosis vs record); compare (FDR)

Same symptoms read as capture: Citizens United, $5bn lobbying 2025, 2024 megadonors both sides; Land's own text names vote buying and proposes converting lobbying into shares and taxes into 'sovereign rent'; Varoufakis technofeudalism (with Weatherby's reservation) and Doctorow's enshittification as the platform analogy; weaknesses of the counter-diagnosis; Yarvin's 'hope... the right individual'; worst-case reading tested. Figures: money; flow
